searchText: folks, is there a way to detect if the merge has happened in the evm besides TTD=0? maybe exact slot times ? howso? Slot will keep accumulating regardless? You can use DIFFICULTY/PREVRANDAO opcode for that. If returns the difficulty before the merge, and randao reveal that is much higher than difficulty afterwards. From the EIP: > This can be done by analyzing the return value of the `DIFFICULTY` instruction. A value greater than `2**64` indicates that the transaction is being executed in the PoS block Shame, hoped there would be an alternative. Will be using that, thank you sers! I've read some claims that the beacon chain would have been insecure with less that 4096 activate validators at Genesis, could someone give me a few more infos on why this would have been the case? Min 4096 validators Is Goerli hashrate also pushed like the last testnets to achieve TTD at a targeted time? If so what would the target be? goerli is proof-of-authority so we can't throw extra hashpower and speed anything up use this for the best timing estimate: https://bordel.wtf I am aware that there is a security issue with the merge related to infura that makes the network more vulnerable to a DDOS attack, would asking the PoW miners to lower the block gas target leading up to the merge mitigate this risk? I don't believe there is such a security issue. Are you referring to the flashbots relay here ? There has been no security issue on infura Ya went back and listened to the dev meeting that it was brought up and I resized I didn't actually understand the issue, I thought that the MEV boost relayers was referring to infura and thought the concern was that the relayers could get DDOSed. Mev boost relayers are currently run by flashbots. And there is a DDOS vulnerability to them Although, in the current mainnet flashbots relay are run the exact same way so the DDOS risk is still up there now

excerpts.author: mjc9
excerpts.content: folks, is there a way to detect if the merge has happened in the evm besides TTD=0?

excerpts.author: mjc9
excerpts.content: howso? Slot will keep accumulating regardless?

excerpts.author: alexssd7fp
excerpts.content: You can use DIFFICULTY/PREVRANDAO opcode for that. If returns the difficulty before the merge, and randao reveal that is much higher than difficulty afterwards.

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
From the EIP:
> This can be done by analyzing the return value of the `DIFFICULTY` instruction. A value greater than `2**64` indicates that the transaction is being executed in the PoS block
